dhikr_text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: alllahu laa iilaaha iillaa huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu laa taakhudhuhu sinahun walaa nawmun llahu maa fiy alssamaawaati wamaa fiy alaardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iillaa biidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aaydiyhim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iillaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamaawaati waalaarda walaa ya'uwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever says it when in the morning will be protected from jinn until.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Morning Azkar. Meaning: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever says it when in the morning will be protected from jinn until. (Source: Al-Baqarah: 255 (An-Nasa'i & At-Tabarani)).

dhikr_text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
transliteration: aasbahnaa waasbaha almulku lilaahi waalhamdu lilaahi laa iilaha iilaa allaahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulii shay'in qadiyrun rabii aasaaluka khayra maa fiy hadhaa alyawmi wakhayra maa ba'dahu waa'uwdhu bika min sharii maa fiy hadhaa alyawmi washarii maa ba'dahu rabii aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali wasuw'i alkibari rabii aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabin fiy alnaari wa'adhaabin fiy alqabri.
short_virtue_for_card: Protection and care from Allah in this life and the hereafter.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Morning Azkar. Meaning: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Protection and care from Allah in this life and the hereafter. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#2723)).

transliteration: allaahumaa aanta rabiiy laa iilaha iilaa aanta khalaqtaniy waanaa 'abduka waanaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika maa astata'tu aa'uwdhu bika min sharii maa sana'tu aabuw'u laka bini'matika 'alayaa waabuw'u bidhanbiy faaghfir liy faiinaahu laa yaghfiru aldhuunuwba iilaa aanta.
short_virtue_for_card: Saying it with certainty in the morning or evening guarantees Paradise if one.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Morning Azkar. Meaning: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Saying it with certainty in the morning or evening guarantees Paradise if one. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#6306)).

transliteration: alllahu laa iilaaha iillaa huwa alhayyu alqayyuwmu laa taakhudhuhu sinahun walaa nawmun llahu maa fiy alssamaawaati wamaa fiy alaardi man dhaa alladhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iillaa biidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aaydiyhim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuhiytuwna bishay'in mmin 'ilmihi iillaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhu alssamaawaati waalaarda walaa ya'uwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyyu al'aziymu
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever says it when in the morning will be protected from jinn until.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Evening Azkar. Meaning: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever says it when in the morning will be protected from jinn until. (Source: Al-Baqarah: 255 (An-Nasa'i & At-Tabarani)).

transliteration: aamsaynaa waamsaa almulku lilaahi waalhamdu lilaahi laa iilaha iilaa allaahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulii shay'in qadiyrun rabii aasaaluka khayra maa fiy hadhihi allaaylahi wakhayra maa ba'dahaa waa'uwdhu bika min sharii maa fiy hadhihi allaaylahi washarii maa ba'dahaa rabii aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali wasuw'i alkibari rabii aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabin fiy alnaari wa'adhaabin fiy alqabri.
short_virtue_for_card: Protection and care from Allah in this life and the hereafter.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Evening Azkar. Meaning: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Protection and care from Allah in this life and the hereafter. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#2723)).

dhikr_text: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ.
transliteration: aamana alrrasuwlu bimaa aunzila iilayhi min rabbihi waalmu'minuwna kullun aamana bialllahi wamalaa'ikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi laa nufarriqu bayna aahadin min rusulihi waqaaluwa sami'naa waata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa waiilayka almasiyru laa yukallifu alllahu nafsana iillaa wus'ahaa lahaa maa kasabat wa'alayhaa maa aktasabat rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa iin nasiynaa aaw aakhtaanaa rabbanaa walaa tahmil 'alaynaa iisrana kamaa hamaltahu 'alaa alladhiyna min qablinaa rabbanaa walaa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqaha lanaa bihi waa'fu 'annaa waaghfir lanaa waarhamnaa aanta mawlaanaa faansurnaa 'alaa alqawmi alkaafiriyna.
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Evening Azkar. Meaning: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say, 'We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination.' Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. 'Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.' Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will. (Source: Al-Bukhari & Muslim (#4008)).

dhikr_text:
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ﴾
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ﴾
transliteration: bismi allaahi alraahmaani alraahiymi qul huwa allaahu aahadun allaahu alsaamadu lam yalid walam yuwlad walam yakun lahu kufuwana aahadun bismi allaahi alraahmaani alraahiymi qul aa'uwdhu birabii alfalaqi min sharii maa khalaqa wamin sharii ghaasiqin iidhaa waqaba wamin sharii alnaafaathaati fiy al'uqadi wamin sharii haasidin iidhaa hasada bismi allaahi alraahmaani alraahiymi qul aa'uwdhu birabii alnaasi maliki alnaasi iilahi alnaasi min sharii alwaswaasi alkhanaasi alaadhiy yuwaswisu fiy suduwri alnaasi mina aljinaahi waalnaasi
short_virtue_for_card: The Prophet used to do this three times every night when going to bed.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. Meaning: Say, 'He is Allah, One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge; He neither begets nor is born; nor is there to Him any equivalent.' — Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of that which He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of the blowers in knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.' — Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers into the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.' Recite it 3 times with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The Prophet used to do this three times every night when going to bed. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#5017)).

dhikr_text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
transliteration: allaahu laa iilaaha iilaa huwa alhayuu alqayuuwmu laa taakhudhuhu sinahun walaa nawmun lahu maa fiy alsaamaawaati wamaa fiy alaardi man dhaa alaadhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iilaa biidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aaydiyhim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuhiytuwna bishay'in min 'ilmihi iilaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyuuhu alsaamaawaati waalaarda walaa ya'uwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyuu al'aziymu
short_virtue_for_card: A guardian from Allah will protect you and no devil will come near.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. Meaning: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: A guardian from Allah will protect you and no devil will come near. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (Al-Baqarah: 255) (#2311)).

audit_notes: نص صحيح محقق ومطابق لمصدره في حصن المسلم أو الصحيحين.
dhikr_text: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
transliteration: biasmika rabiiy wada'tu janbiy wabika aarfa'uhu faiin aamsakta nafsiy faarhamhaa waiin aarsaltahaa faahfazhaa bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadaka alsaalihiyna.
short_virtue_for_card: Entrusting one's soul to Allah when sleeping.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. Meaning: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Entrusting one's soul to Allah when sleeping. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari & Muslim (#6320)).

audit_notes: نص صحيح محقق ومطابق لمصدره في حصن المسلم أو الصحيحين.
dhikr_text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ. اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
transliteration: allaahumaa rabaa alsaamaawaati alsaab'i warabaa al'arshi al'aziymi rabaanaa warabaa kulii shay'in faaliqa alhabii waalnaawaa wamunzila altaawraahi waaliinjiyli waalfurqaani aa'uwdhu bika min sharii kulii shay'in aanta aakhidhun binaasiyatihi. allaahumaa aanta alaawaalu falaysa qablaka shay'un waanta alaakhiru falaysa ba'daka shay'un waanta alzaahiru falaysa fawqaka shay'un waanta albaatinu falaysa duwnaka shay'un aqdi 'anaa aldaayna waaghninaa mina alfaqri.
short_virtue_for_card: An established Sunnah supplication before sleep for settling debts.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. Meaning: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date-stone, Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Criterion, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You seize by the forelock. O Allah, You are the First so there is nothing before You, and You are the Last so there is nothing after You, and You are the Manifest so there is nothing above You, and You are the Hidden so there is nothing closer than You. Settle our debt and spare us from poverty. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: An established Sunnah supplication before sleep for settling debts. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#2713)).

transliteration: allaahumaa 'aalima alghaybi waalshaahaadahi faatira alsaamaawaati waalaardi rabaa kulii shay'in wamaliykahu aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaa aanta aa'uwdhu bika min sharii nafsiy wamin sharii alshaaytaani washirkihi waan aaqtarifa 'alaa nafsiy suw'ana aaw aajuraahu iilaa muslimin.
short_virtue_for_card: Said in the morning, evening, and when going to bed.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. Meaning: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the evident, Maker of the heavens and the earth, Lord of everything and its Possessor, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his helpers. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Said in the morning, evening, and when going to bed. (Source: Abu Dawud & At-Tirmidhi (#5067)).

detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Sleep Azkar. transliteration: allaahu laa iilaaha iilaa huwa alhayuu alqayuuwmu laa taakhudhuhu sinahun walaa nawmun lahu maa fiy alsaamaawaati wamaa fiy alaardi man dhaa alaadhiy yashfa'u 'indahu iilaa biidhnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aaydiyhim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuhiytuwna bishay'in min 'ilmihi iilaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyuuhu alsaamaawaati waalaarda walaa ya'uwduhu hifzuhumaa wahuwa al'aliyuu al'aziymu
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to After Prayer Azkar. Meaning: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after every obligatory prayer, nothing prevents him from entering. (Source: An-Nasa'i & At-Tabarani (Al-Baqarah: 255) (#9928)).

dhikr_text: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ ۝ الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَامًا وَقُعُودًا وَعَلَى جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ ۝ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَنْ تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ ۖ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنْصَارٍ ۝ رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا ۚ رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ ۝ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ۗ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ ۝ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لَا أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِنْكُمْ مِنْ ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنْثَى ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ۖ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا وَأُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُوا فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُوا وَقُتِلُوا لَأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلَأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ ثَوَابًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَاللَّهُ عِنْدَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ ۝ لَا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ ۝ مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ ۝ لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْا رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِلْأَبْرَارِ ۝ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَنْ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لَا يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا ۗ أُولَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ ۝ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

short_virtue_for_card: Whoever says this sincerely from his heart will enter Paradise.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Adhan Azkar. Virtue: Whoever says this sincerely from his heart will enter Paradise. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari & Muslim (#611)).

dhikr_text: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا.
transliteration: waanaa aashhadu aan laa iilaha iilaa allaahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu waanaa muhamaadana 'abduhu warasuwluhu radiytu biallaahi rabanana wabimuhamaadin rasuwlana wabialiislaami diynana.
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever says it upon hearing the Mu'adhin, his sins will be forgiven.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Adhan Azkar. Meaning: And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Muhammad as Messenger, and Islam as religion. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever says it upon hearing the Mu'adhin, his sins will be forgiven. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#386)).

short_virtue_for_card: Send blessings upon the Prophet after repeating the Adhan; Allah sends ten blessings.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Adhan Azkar. Meaning: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Send blessings upon the Prophet after repeating the Adhan; Allah sends ten blessings. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#384)).

dhikr_text: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ.

short_virtue_for_card: My intercession will be granted to him on the Day of Judgment.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Adhan Azkar. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: My intercession will be granted to him on the Day of Judgment. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#614)).

Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The complete prophetic supplication for travel. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#1342)).

audit_notes: نص صحيح محقق ومطابق لمصدره في حصن المسلم أو الصحيحين.
dhikr_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
transliteration: allaahumaa iiniiy aa'uwdhu bika mina alhamii waalhazani waal'ajzi waalkasali waalbukhli waaljubni wadala'i aldaayni waghalabahi alriijaali.
short_virtue_for_card: The Prophet used to frequently make this supplication.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Worry Dua. Meaning: O Allah, I take refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The Prophet used to frequently make this supplication. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#6369)).

dhikr_text: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.

None has the right to be worshipped except You. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The supplication of the distressed, entrusting all affairs to Allah. (Source: Abu Dawud & Ahmad (#5090)).

audit_notes: إكمال الترجمة الإنجليزية الكاملة لدعاء الاستخارة دون اختصار وتوحيد التشكيل.
dhikr_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ.
transliteration: allaahumaa iiniiy aastakhiyruka bi'ilmika waastaqdiruka biqudratika waasaaluka min fadlika al'aziymi faiinaaka taqdiru walaa aaqdiru wata'lamu walaa aa'lamu waanta 'alaamu alghuyuwbi. allaahumaa iin kunta ta'lamu aanaa hadhaa alaamra khayrun liy fiy diyniy wama'aashiy wa'aaqibahi aamriy faaqdurhu liy wayasiirhu liy thumaa baarik liy fiyhi waiin kunta ta'lamu aanaa hadhaa alaamra sharunun liy fiy diyniy wama'aashiy wa'aaqibahi aamriy faasrifhu 'aniiy waasrifniy 'anhu waaqdur liya alkhayra haythu kaana thumaa aardiniy bihi.
short_virtue_for_card: Pray two non-obligatory rak'ahs then supplicate with this; whoever seeks Allah's guidance will.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Istikhara Dua. Meaning: O Allah, I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge, and I seek Your assistance by Your power, and I ask You from Your immense favour. For indeed You are able while I am not, and You know while I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know this matter to be good for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless me in it. And if You know this matter to be harmful for me in my religion, my livelihood, and the outcome of my affair, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me content with it. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Pray two non-obligatory rak'ahs then supplicate with this; whoever seeks Allah's guidance will. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#1162)).

transliteration: rabaanaa taqabaal minaa iinaaka aanta alsaamiy'u al'aliymu rabaanaa waaj'alnaa muslimayni laka wamin dhuriiyaatinaa aumaahan muslimahan laka waarinaa manaasikanaa watub 'alaynaa iinaaka aanta altaawaabu alraahiymu
short_virtue_for_card: Supplication of Ibrahim and Isma'il while raising the foundations of the Kaaba.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Quran Duas. Meaning: Our Lord, accept this from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing. Our Lord, and make us Muslims in submission to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation in submission to You. And show us our rites and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Supplication of Ibrahim and Isma'il while raising the foundations of the Kaaba. (Source: Al-Baqarah: 127-128).

dhikr_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ.
transliteration: bismi allaahi aarqiyka min kulii shay'in yu'dhiyka min sharii kulii nafsin aaw 'ayni haasidin allaahu yashfiyka bismi allaahi aarqiyka.
short_virtue_for_card: The ruqyah of Jibreel for the Prophet.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Ruqyah. Meaning: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that is harming you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye may Allah heal you, in the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you. Recite it 3 times with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The ruqyah of Jibreel for the Prophet. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#2186)).

dhikr_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ.
transliteration: aa'uwdhu bikalimaati allaahi altaamaahi min kulii shaytaanin wahaamaahin wamin kulii 'aynin laamaahin.
short_virtue_for_card: The Prophet used to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with it.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Ruqyah. Meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous pest, and from every envious blameworthy eye. Recite it 3 times with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: The Prophet used to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with it. (Source: Sahih Al-Bukhari (#3371)).

transliteration: bismi allaahi thalaathana aa'uwdhu biallaahi waqudratihi min sharii maa aajidu waauhaadhiru.
short_virtue_for_card: Prophetic remedy for physical pain in the body.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Ruqyah. Meaning: Place your hand on the area of pain, say 'Bismillah' (3 times), then say 7 times: 'I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.' Recite it 7 times with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Prophetic remedy for physical pain in the body. (Source: Sahih Muslim (#2202)).

audit_notes: استبدال الوصف المختصر بكتابة سورة الفاتحة وآية الكرسي وخواتيم البقرة والمعوذات الثلاث كاملةً بالتشكيل القرآني الكامل.
dhikr_text:
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ ۝ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ ۝ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ ۝ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ ۝ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ﴾
﴿اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ ۝ لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ۖ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا ۚ أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ﴾
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ﴾
﴿بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ﴾

dhikr_text: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلَاكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا.
transliteration: alhamdu lilaahi alaadhiy 'aafaaniy mimaa abtalaaka bihi wafadaalaniy 'alaa kathiyrin mimaan khalaqa tafdiylana.
short_virtue_for_card: Whoever sees an afflicted person and says this quietly will be spared that affliction.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to General Azkar. Meaning: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He has afflicted you with, and blessed me greatly over many of those whom He has created. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Whoever sees an afflicted person and says this quietly will be spared that affliction. (Source: At-Tirmidhi & Ibn Majah (#3432)).

dhikr_text: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
transliteration: laa iilaha iilaa allaahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu yuhyiy wayumiytu wahuwa hayunun laa yamuwtu biyadihi alkhayru wahuwa 'alaa kulii shay'in qadiyrun.
short_virtue_for_card: A million good deeds are recorded for him, a million bad deeds erased.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Market Dua. Meaning: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things omnipotent. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: A million good deeds are recorded for him, a million bad deeds erased. (Source: At-Tirmidhi & Ibn Majah (#3428)).

short_virtue_for_card: Even if you had debt like a mountain, Allah would settle it for you.
detailed_explanation: This authentic remembrance belongs to Market Dua. Meaning: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You by Your bounty. Recite it once with mindfulness and serenity. Virtue: Even if you had debt like a mountain, Allah would settle it for you. (Source: Sunan At-Tirmidhi (Hasan — Hisn Al-Muslim) (#3563)).
